seed: Objects of type `player` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: y x13, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) + beam (arm) move by 6 on the rail; blocks fully on the beam (any tag) are carried, moved rects push other blocks as a chain.
Player A1 y vs no_change: decided by geometry, not an object field. The move cancels if the ring or any carried/pushed block would leave the colour-4 field (field-top cancel).
A4/A3 grow/shrink the beam by 6 (w in [1, field]). A hooked next block (x == tip-5) drags the on-beam group. If a block would leave the field, the beam moves alone.
Tags: next is collected when hooked and alone on the beam among uncollected blocks, and reverts when off the beam. Legend centre 2x2 = 0 while collected. HUD 3s from the right = (n-1)//3, where n counts non-click actions.
Not confirmed: A5/A7 (never observed). n is hidden state, gated on the returned frame; fallback is 3*threes+1.
